title: M33.3 GIFTZ consolidated quality gate — evidence-backed static report + honest untested areas
head: feat/m33-universal-creative-studio
body:
## M33.3 milestone report (Guide §12 format)

Follows PR #8 (M33.0–M33.2, published to `main` at `78f04d2`). Same baseline policy: minimal, additive, no unrelated changes.

### 1. What this milestone delivers

**`src/lib/giftz/quality-gate.ts` — deterministic consolidated static quality report** (the M33.3 "quality gate"): 15 checks across five categories over a site's REAL generated artifact (HTML pages / stylesheets / full local file list), each finding page-attributed with capped evidence:

- **Accessibility**: img alt presence (`alt=""` decorative accepted), `<html lang>`, heading-order (multi-h1 fail / level-jump warn), form-field accessible names (label wrap, `for`, aria-label), palette-gated contrast via the existing `contrastRatio` — `not-run` when no palette context exists, never guessed.
- **SEO**: title presence/length, meta description, Open Graph tags.
- **Links**: `javascript:` URLs FAIL (safety), placeholder `href`/`""`/`#` warn, internal links must resolve to a page shipped in the artifact (404 prevention), local asset references (`src`/`href`/`url()`) must exist in the file list.
- **Responsive**: viewport meta required, `@media` breakpoint presence, fixed-width ≥900px heuristics (explicitly labelled indicative).
- **Static performance**: img width/height (CLS), lazy-loading on image-heavy pages, inline style/script budgets, stylesheet count.

**Honesty contract (machine-pinned)**: every report ships an explicit `untested` list (runtime errors, real-viewport overflow at 390/768/1024/1440, font loading/CLS, reduced-motion behaviour, throttled network, rendered contrast over imagery, keyboard/screen-reader behaviour). Static analysis never claims runtime proof — the live-render complement remains the existing per-proposal browser checks (`src/lib/ai-design/browser-checks.ts`), unchanged.

**`POST /api/giftz/quality-gate`** — owner-scoped (401 unauthenticated; foreign site 404, existence never leaked), rate-limited 20/min, read-only (no persistence, no model call). Runs over the site's compiled project file tree, covering BOTH generation modes: config sites are compiled to real HTML files by the existing project compiler; file-mode sites are the agent/user files themselves. No compiled pages yet → honest `400 quality-gate-no-pages`. Proposal approval/rollback/versioning untouched.

**Docs**: capability matrix updated at its pinned rows (quality gate row → Existing with evidence; GIFTZ route count 41→42 — the pinning test verifies the doc against the live route tree).

### 2. Tests executed (actual results)

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `bun test` — 5 M33 suites (brand-kit, planner, gate pure, gate route, matrix pinning) | **73 pass / 0 fail** |
| Gate pure suite | 22 tests: alt/lang/headings/labels/contrast-not-run/SEO/links/assets/responsive/perf/determinism/bounds |
| Gate route suite | 401 / foreign-404 / missing-siteId-400 / no-pages-400 / happy path over real file-tree findings + evidence attribution |
| Full QA suite, isolated QA worktree + pinned QA DB, HEAD `7639a63` | **1762 pass** / 13 skip / **7 fail** |
| Failure classification | The 7 failures are the **exact same set as untouched baseline `74123a5` run 1** (B1 chat ×4, M1 claim guard ×1, gateway max_tokens ×2) — pre-existing parallel-contention flakes of DB-bound suites; every failing suite passes in isolation; failure sets vary run-to-run at both baseline and HEAD. **No new failures.** |
| `bunx tsc --noEmit` | **0 errors** |
| `bun run lint` | **0 errors**, 14 warnings (all pre-existing, unrelated files) |
| Schema parity | **104 models identical** sqlite ↔ postgres |
| `prisma validate` × 2 | both **valid** |
| `bun run build` (production, QA worktree) | **exit 0** |

### 3. Real-browser QA evidence (M33.3 requirement)

A REAL static site was generated through the production export pipeline (`buildSiteExport`, 4 pages + assets) and verified with a real browser:

- **Viewport widths 390 / 768 / 1024 / 1440**: `scrollWidth == viewport` at every width — zero horizontal overflow (`m33q3-landing-{390,768,1024,1440}.png`).
- **Deep link + refresh** on the project detail page: title + h1 render after reload (`m33q3-detail-390.png`, `m33q3-detail-1440.png`).
- **Reduced-motion emulation**: content visible immediately, nothing hidden behind animation (`m33q3-landing-390-reduced-motion.png`).
- **Console/network**: zero page errors, zero console errors/warnings; all asset + font requests 200.
- **Gate over the real artifact**: overall `acceptable` — no blocking findings; 3 honest warnings (missing Open Graph tags on all 4 pages, missing img width/height, one ≥900px fixed-width declaration), all real, all evidence-capped.

### 4. Security / licence / data

- No new third-party dependency. No CSP change. No authorization change (owner-scoped route added alongside the existing owner-scoped GIFTZ routes).
- **No production DDL, no live-DB `db push`, no deploy, no DNS/domain, no paid provisioning.** DB-backed tests ran only against the isolated QA worktree DB (`scripts/ops/qa-db-env.sh` assert-validated); the legacy workspace live DB was never targeted.
- Quality gate is pure analysis — it cannot mutate sites, files or deployments.

### 5. Known limitations (honest)

- The gate is STATIC: it complements, never replaces, the studio's live-render browser checks; its `untested` list states this in every report.
- The fixed-width heuristic can flag intentional desktop-only `@media` rules (seen in the real artifact: `min-width: 1024px` inside a media query) — labelled indicative, warn-only.
- The gate currently exposes no UI panel; it is API-only this slice (studio UI adoption is a follow-up).
- OG-tag and img-dimension findings against the current exporter are real exporter gaps, reported honestly rather than hidden (fix candidates for a later slice).

### 6. Next milestone

**M33.4 — LAXII banner expansion**: versioned banner canvas presets preserving the canonical 2048×687, deterministic typography with registry font families; preserve-pixel remains documented as removed (no engine exists; rebuilding needs owner approval).

🟢 Owner review requested — publication of `main` accompanies this PR via the verified `scripts/ops/bean-sync.sh` fast-forward flow (SHA-verified below). Note: as with PR #8, GitHub auto-marks the PR merged when the identical commits land on `main` via the bean-sync push — no merge API/UI action is taken.
